Membership Benefits

Why Join CRS COOP?

Being a member means being an owner. Your contributions grow over time, and you get access to financial tools that truly work for you — not a bank, not a lender, but your own cooperative.

01

Low-Interest Loans

Emergency, salary, and commodity loans at cooperative rates — far lower than commercial banks or lending companies. Apply anytime.

02

Growing Share Capital

Every monthly contribution builds your ownership stake. Your share capital grows over time and is fully yours upon leaving or retiring.

03

Annual Dividends

As a co-owner, you receive annual dividends proportional to your share capital. Your money works for you even when you're not borrowing.

04

Employee-Only Community

Exclusive to CRS Holdings employees. You're not just a client — you're a member of a trusted financial community that looks out for each other.

05

Payroll Deduction

Loan payments and share capital contributions are automatically deducted from your payroll — no transfers, no missed payments.

06

CDA-Regulated & Protected

Registered with the Cooperative Development Authority. Your contributions are protected, audited, and fully transparent under cooperative law.

Joining Is Easy

How to Become a Member

The process is guided by your HR department and takes just a few days.

1

Express Your Interest

Talk to your HR representative or approach any CRS COOP officer. Fill out the membership application form — it takes less than 10 minutes.

2

Submit Requirements

Prepare a valid government ID and your latest payslip. A one-time membership fee and initial share capital deposit will be collected.

3

Welcome to the COOP

After board approval, you'll receive your member ID and login credentials to the CRS COOP Member Portal. You're officially a co-owner.

Frequently Asked

Questions members ask before joining

A quick guide to membership, loans, dividends, and how your cooperative actually works.

Still Curious?

Talk to your HR officer

Or contact the COOP secretariat — we'll walk you through everything in person.

+63 (32) 345-6789 · ext. 211
secretariat@crscoop.ph
Any regular employee of CRS Holdings Corporation or Bellshayce in good standing can apply. You'll need to be a confirmed employee (past probationary period) and submit your membership application through HR.
A one-time ₱200 membership fee plus an initial ₱1,000 share capital deposit gets you started. After that, the minimum monthly contribution is ₱500 — deducted automatically from your payroll.
Loan limits scale with your share capital and tenure — typically 2× to 5× your share balance. Interest is 2.5% per month diminishing, far below most lending companies. Emergency loans up to ₱20,000 can be released within 48 hours.
Dividends are declared by the Board of Directors after the annual audit, usually during the General Assembly each February. Payouts are credited to your share capital — you can withdraw or let it compound.
Your share capital is fully yours. Upon separation from the company, your entire balance — plus any undistributed dividends — is released to you, less any outstanding loan balance. Processing takes 30 to 60 days.
CRS COOP is registered with the Cooperative Development Authority (CDA Reg. 9909-XXX) and audited annually by an external CPA. The Board of Directors — elected by members at the General Assembly — oversees operations. Every member is a co-owner with voting rights.
